product_one_liner.value: Envoy provides facility, security, and IT teams with a connected workplace management platform for managing visitors, spaces, and workplace communications.
product_one_liner.notes: Envoy describes its product as a connected workplace platform unifying visitors, spaces, and communications and says it serves facility leaders, security teams, and IT teams.

pricing_page.notes: Envoy has a public pricing page with an Enterprise plan and a custom-pricing/get-a-quote option.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Envoy case-study pages identify Conductor, Headspace, and G+D as customers. | named_customers.0: The cited Envoy case study names Conductor. | named_customers.1: The cited Envoy case study names Headspace. | named_customers.2: The customer-story page says G+D welcomes visitors with Envoy.

employee_band.notes: The Envoy Inc company profile reports 463 employees, which falls in the 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Envoy’s About page explicitly labels its San Francisco office as HQ. | hq_country: The Envoy Inc profile identifies the locality as San Francisco, California, and the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The Envoy Inc company profile gives the founded year as 2013.

eng_blog.notes: Envoy’s engineering blog links to a technical post on its Kafka/LLM/geospatial threat-detection pipeline and another on rendering React inside Ember, meeting the two-post technical-content threshold.

public_docs.notes: Envoy’s developer portal provides step-by-step guides and API documentation, establishing a public documentation site.

model_provider.notes: Envoy’s AI-usage documentation states that Anthropic’s Claude model is processed through Amazon Bedrock.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Envoy’s compliance page names GDPR, SOC 2, and PCI DSS among its compliance standards, and the Trust Center badge identifies ISO/IEC 27001. | compliance_certs.0: The Envoy compliance page names Service Organization Controls (SOC 2). | compliance_certs.1: The Envoy Trust Center badge names ISO/IEC 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The Envoy compliance page names the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). | compliance_certs.3: The Envoy compliance page names the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS).

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding-history profile labels Envoy’s latest round Series C. | funding_date: The funding-history profile dates Envoy’s latest Series C round to January 2022. | funding_amount_usd: The funding-history profile identifies the latest round as a $111.0 million Series C in January 2022.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile and Envoy’s announcement show the latest known round was the $111 million Series C in January 2022, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current Envoy job postings include an EMEA Outbound BDR and an SMB Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Envoy’s AI information page announces Envoy Response on August 6, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Envoy’s February 26, 2026 newsroom item announces Mauricio Ramirez as Chief Revenue Officer, a C-level appointment within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Envoy sales job postings name Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6Sense, ZoomInfo, and Chorus as sales tools and identify Nooks in the current stack. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Envoy Mid Market Account Executive posting names Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The Envoy sales posting names Outreach. | crm_stack_signal.2: The Envoy sales posting names LinkedIn Sales Navigator. | crm_stack_signal.3: The Envoy sales posting names 6Sense. | crm_stack_signal.4: The Envoy sales posting names ZoomInfo. | crm_stack_signal.5: The Envoy sales posting names Chorus. | crm_stack_signal.6: The Envoy EMEA Outbound BDR posting names Nooks in the current sales tech stack.
